rule: S_N must not contain null values.
rationale: S_N is the join key and a mandatory identifier; any null would break joins.

rule: S_N values should be unique across the table.
rationale: Evidence describes S_N as a near‑unique identifier (29 distinct values out of 30 rows).

rule: Account_No must not contain null values.
rationale: Account_No is a core business identifier; the column has 0 % missing but is required.

rule: Account_No must be exactly four numeric digits.
rationale: All observed values are four‑character numeric strings (e.g., "1026").

rule: Full_Name must not contain null values.
rationale: Full_Name is required for downstream reporting; the column has 0 % missing.

rule: Full_Name should follow title case for all words except known particles (bin, binte, d/o, s/o).
rationale: Sample contains lower‑case entries ("irfan", "junrong") and mixed‑case entries ("Lee yixuan"); business wants a consistent title‑case format.

check_params.logic: any(w[0].islower() for w in str(row['Full_Name']).split() if w.lower() not in ('bin','binte','d/o','s/o') and len(w)>1)

rule: ID must match either a 9‑character pattern (letter + 7 digits + letter) or a 7‑character pattern (letter + 6 digits).
rationale: 96.7 % of values follow the 9‑character pattern; 3.3 % follow the shorter 7‑character pattern.

rule: JoinDate must not contain null values.
rationale: JoinDate is a historical timestamp; 1 null (3.3 %) was observed, which should be flagged.

rule: JoinDate must not be a future date.
rationale: JoinDate records when a customer joined; future dates (e.g., 2027‑01‑15) are invalid.

rule: JoinDate must match the datetime format YYYY‑MM‑DD HH:MM:SS.
rationale: All parseable values follow this exact pattern; one value ('2025-13-01') is unparseable and should be caught.

rule: LastLogin must match the datetime format YYYY‑MM‑DD HH:MM:SS.
rationale: All observed timestamps follow this format; enforcing it prevents malformed entries.

rule: Subscription_Type must be one of the known tier values.
rationale: Only five distinct tiers appear in the data; any other value is unexpected.

rule: SubscriptionFee must not contain null values.
rationale: 6.7 % of rows have nulls; the fee is required for revenue calculations.

rule: SubscriptionFee must be parseable as a numeric value.
rationale: One observed value ('free') cannot be converted to a number; the column is intended as float64.

rule: Flag sentinel placeholder values in SubscriptionFee.
rationale: The non‑numeric entry 'free' is clearly a placeholder rather than a legitimate fee.

rule: Status must use the dominant boolean representations True or False
rationale: Six variants (0,1,False,True,no,yes) are observed; any other value is unexpected.

rule: AccountBalance must not be negative.
rationale: Balances represent monetary amounts; a negative value (-150.5) is likely erroneous.

rule: PreferredLanguage must be one of the supported language codes.
rationale: Only five languages appear in the sample; any other value is out of scope.

rule: Device must be one of the recognized device types.
rationale: Only three distinct device categories are observed.

rule: OS must be one of the canonical operating‑system names.
rationale: Observed values are case variants of a small set; standardising to canonical casing improves consistency.

rule: FeedbackScore should be between 1.0 and 5.0 inclusive.
rationale: Feedback scores are typical 1‑5 ratings; the observed outlier 7.3 is likely a sentinel.

rule: FeedbackScore1 should be between 1.0 and 5.0 inclusive.
rationale: Same business meaning as FeedbackScore; enforce identical bounds.

rule: Every S_N value must exist in Cust_Bio_dirty.S_N.
rationale: Join hint declares a one‑to‑one relationship; referential integrity is required.

rule: JoinDate must be on or before LastLogin.
rationale: A customer cannot log in before they have joined.

rule: If Subscription_Type is 'Free' then SubscriptionFee must be null or zero.
rationale: Free tier should not carry a monetary fee; records with a fee for a free subscription are inconsistent.

rule: Account_No must be unique within Acc_Info_dirty
rationale: Column is 93.3% distinct with duplicate value(s) [1001, 1010] observed; treated as a candidate identifier — duplicates flagged for review.

rule: AccountBalance must not contain sentinel placeholder values
rationale: Profiler detected [99999.0, '99999'] as statistically outlying sentinel-coded value(s) in AccountBalance.

rule: FeedbackScore must not contain sentinel placeholder values
rationale: Profiler detected [7.3] as statistically outlying sentinel-coded value(s) in FeedbackScore.
